story: You are a Blue Defence maintenance technician servicing a Sentinel-7 unmanned surface vessel. You want the tightening torque for the propulsion pod mounting bolts.
starting_sentence: What torque should the Sentinel-7 propulsion pod mounting bolts be tightened to?

args.query: Sentinel-7 propulsion pod mounting bolt torque

goal_details.name: answer
goal_details.response: Tighten the Sentinel-7 propulsion pod mounting bolts to 85 N·m, from sentinel-7-maintenance-manual.pdf.
